name: British Columbia

flag.description: The upper part shows the Union Jack with a gold crown at its centre; below, a gold sun sets behind wavy blue and white horizontal bands.
flag.symbolism: The Union Jack and crown recall the province's British origins, the waves stand for the Pacific Ocean, and the setting sun marks British Columbia as Canada's westernmost province.

hook: British Columbia puts the Union Jack on top and a sun setting into the Pacific below; Kiribati has the same sun and waves but a red sky with a frigatebird instead.
trivia: The provincial motto, "Splendor sine occasu" ("Splendour without diminishment"), plays on the setting sun shown on the arms and flag.
Queen Victoria chose the name "British Columbia" for the new colony in 1858.
